summary: Backend + frontend testing of the full VIP system (iteration 86). All 6 backend tests pass (auth, daily-briefing via native openai gpt-5.6-terra, vip/ai/analyze, tools/fear-greed, tools/halving, unauthorized). Frontend visually renders every VIP feature correctly for the super admin: golden VIP badge + VIP Hub menu on profile, Daily Briefing with live AI-generated content, Fear & Greed + Halving stat cards, Pro Tools grid on VIP Hub, image upload icon in Atlas chat, $21.99 pricing + Become VIP button on /vip. Only issue: the data-testid attributes referenced in the spec (vip-badge, vip-tool-*, chart-upload-btn) are NOT present in the DOM, so automated selector-based tests cannot target them.

minor.issue: Review spec says POST but endpoint is implemented as GET (works fine with query param lang=fr). Update spec or add POST alias for consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Golden VIP badge renders correctly but is missing data-testid="vip-badge"
Pro Tools grid renders correctly but tool cards are missing data-testid="vip-tool-{id}"
Image/camera upload icon is visible for VIP on web (bottom-left of message input) but is missing data-testid="chart-upload-btn"
Root URL '/' shows the onboarding/marketing page even for authenticated users; could not visually verify a VIP badge on the actual home tab. Also no data-testid="vip-badge" found anywhere at '/'.

issues: React Native Web console errors: 'Invalid style property animationName. Did you mean animationKeyframes?' (persists from iteration 85 - not yet fixed)
The PWA install bottom sheet overlaps chat input area on /learn and /(tabs) - should be dismissible or shown only once per session

action_items: Add data-testid="vip-badge" to the VIP badge TouchableOpacity in profile.tsx and to the home header badge in (tabs)/index.tsx
Add data-testid="vip-tool-{id}" to the tool grid cards in vip/hub.tsx
Add data-testid="chart-upload-btn" to the image upload TouchableOpacity in (tabs)/learn.tsx (Atlas chat)
Fix RN-Web console errors: replace 'animationName' with 'animationKeyframes', 'shadow*' props with boxShadow, and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents
Clarify /vip/daily-briefing verb - spec says POST, code is GET (currently works via GET with ?lang=fr)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 12k+ lines - split into routers (auth/vip/admin/atlas)
daily-briefing writes market_data (with cache_key) then reads it back including cache_key - fine but ensure _id is excluded (already handled via projection)
vip_ai_analyze uses query as a query-string parameter for a POST endpoint; better to accept a Pydantic body model (like ImageAnalysisRequest) for consistency and larger payloads
openai calls in daily-briefing / analyze use reasoning_effort="none" which is a gpt-5.x specific param - ensure client SDK version supports it (works today)
seed_data_creation: None. Backend tests use only the existing super admin account. daily-briefing cache row upserted in db.daily_briefings for cache_key 'YYYY-MM-DD_fr'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_vip_iter86.py (6 tests, all pass in ~14s). Daily-briefing endpoint uses native openai AsyncOpenAI SDK with model gpt-5.6-terra (emergentintegrations removed) and 4h per-language cache in db.daily_briefings. rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs. The 'features not found' during automation was purely due to missing data-testid attributes (elements are present and functional in DOM/screenshots).
